7.3.3.3 SOVD Data Serialization & Data Conversion
The exchange of data from a SOVD Client to a SOVD Server and vice versa takes
place on an interpreted physical level, whereas internally (as well as for UDS ISO
14229-1 [1]) the data is expressed by internal data types. The data is defined
by
DiagnosticSovdContentElement
and aggregated by
DiagnosticSovd-
Content
. To express this transformation
SwDataDefProps
are aggregated by
DiagnosticSovdContentElement
.
This section describes how these transformations shall be interpreted for SOVD and
how the subset of a JSON schema that represents a
DiagnosticSovdContent
shall
be derived based on Diagnostic Extract Template[4], so that the
Diagnostic Server
instance
can offer consistent ASAM SOVD [5] [14] [13] APIs.
7.3.3.3.1 SOVD Data – Serialization
SOVD data is serialized, using settings from
DiagnosticSovdProps.singleEle-
mentSerialization
. The setting
object
is supported by this version of the stan-
dard. See also chapter
Common primitive data types
in ISO 17978-3(2026)
[13].
